RegularBoatCapacity.definition: Number of pieces of mail a regular boat can carry per trip

RegularBoatGasConsumption.definition: Amount of gas (liters) used by a regular boat per trip

SpeedBoatCapacity.definition: Number of pieces of mail a speed boat can carry per trip

SpeedBoatGasConsumption.definition: Amount of gas (liters) used by a speed boat per trip

MaxRegularBoatTrips.definition: Maximum number of trips that can be made by regular boats

MinFractionSpeedBoatTrips.definition: Minimum required fraction of trips to be made by speed boats

TotalMail.definition: Total number of pieces of mail to be delivered
